h:
这是为 Klein（或 Flux2）设计的，但模型和调度程序可以更改为其他编辑模型。

这是根据 Klein 的非基础（涡轮/蒸馏）版本设计的，尽管您也可以使用基础 + 涡轮。非基础 Klein 是 4 步涡轮模型，或者可以使用涡轮 lora - 与 1 CFG 一起使用。如果使用基础，请确保将步数增加到 20+，CFG 增加到 4+

这并不完全是修复，但对于克莱因来说，有时它比修复更好，而且速度更快。

  1. 蒙面或未蒙面- 遮罩速度更快 - 裁剪为矩形，然后合成回遮罩中。非常适合进行小调整。建议使用 1 硬度，否则可能会调整透明区域的大小。在我的 5080 上，屏蔽编辑只需要 2.5 秒。未屏蔽取决于图像大小，当您想要更改整个图像时效果更好

  2. 样品前是否放大 - 可能如果您的裁剪区域太小，请帮助提供更多细节。或者如果使用 unmakesed，如果图像太大，您可以缩小尺寸。我通常把它关掉。

  3. 颜色匹配或不匹配颜色- 如果您正在尝试修复并且想要将颜色恢复到原来的颜色，这绝对是天赐之物。帮助消除油漆痕迹。如果您不需要匹配原始版本（更改样式、黑白等），请关闭

目的

  1. 快速 I2I 图像编辑 - 仅编辑一小部分裁剪并将其合成回来或编辑整个图像，所有这些都通过一个工作流程完成。

  2. 此工作流程非常适合创建新的 I2I 数据集 - 它将以相同的大小和文件类型输出原始版本和编辑后的版本，并且可选的颜色匹配有助于确保两个版本之间的颜色一致。

    请注意，图像编辑模型本身并不总是使拍摄对象保持相同的构图。微调和洛拉可以帮助防止主体移动。您可以调整提示、扩展蒙版或增加批量大小以获得更接近的匹配。

o.en:
This is designed for Klein (or flux2), but the models & scheduler can be changed for other edit models.

This was designed with the non-base (turbo/distilled) version of Klein in mind, though you can also use base+turbo. non-base Klein is 4 step turbo model, or can use the turbo lora - use with 1 CFG. If using base make sure to increase steps to 20+ & CFG to 4+

This is not exactly inpainting, but with Klein, it sometimes is better than inpainting and it is much faster.

  1. Masked or Unmasked- masking is way faster - crops down to rectangle then composites back into your mask. Great for making small tweaks. recommend 1 hardness or it might resize in the transparent areas. Masked editing only takes like 2.5s on my 5080. unmasked depends on image size and better when you want to change the entire image

  2. Upscaled or not before sample - mayhelp with additional details if your cropped area is too small. or if using unmaksed you can downscale if your image is too big. I usually leave it off.

  3. color match or no color match- definitely a godsend if you are trying to inpaint and you want to bring the color back to the original. Helps gets rid of inpaint auras. turn off if you don't need to match the original (changing styles, to black & white, etc

PURPOSE

  1. Fast I2I image editing - edit just a small crop and composite it back or edit the whole image, all with one workflow.

  2. This workflow is great for creating new I2I datasets - it will output the original and edited version in the same size and filetype, and optional color match helps ensure that color is consistent between both versions.

    Note that image edit models by themselves do not always keep subjects in the same composition. finetunes and loras can help prevent subjects from shifting. You can tweak your prompt, expand your mask, or increase batch size to get a closer match.
